Name: Simple Cooking
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[youtube]PmK3yT1-p5U[/youtube]

[b][size=5][u]Overview[/u][/size][/b]

This mod lets you place raw fish or vegetables on a [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Campfire]campfire [/url]or any [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Wooden_Brazier]brazier [/url]and receive grilled versions.

Grilled items retain the quality of the raw item. 

By default, grilled items sell for 1.5x as much and restore 1.25x as much stamina and health as raw counterparts.


[b][size=5][u]Usage[/u][/size][/b]

To cook an item, hold it, walk next to the fire and press the tool use button (e.g. Left Mouse Button).

Grilling takes 10 minutes for vegetables and fish.

Leaving vegetables or fish on for 30 minutes or more will cause them to be burnt.

Burnt items divide the price and edibility by the respective multipliers.

Turning off the fire will pause cooking.

Cooked items emit light smoke that gets darker as they approach burnt state.

You can add categories or items to the config file to make them grillable.

There is an optional file in the Files section that lets this mod work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url], meaning you can put a chest full of raw grillables beside a fire and come back later to a chest full of grilled items.


[b][size=5][u]Advanced[/u][/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Custom Cookables[/size][/b]

You can add Item IDs or even entire categories as grillable items in the config file, e.g.:

  "GrillableItems": [ "myRawThing", "myOtherRawThing" ],

These items will work like veggies and fish, with Grilled and Burnt products.

You can set any object to be a custom cookable using Content Patcher, e.g.:

[code]{
  "Format": "2.7.0",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "EditData",
      "Target": "aedenthorn.SimpleCooking/cookable",
      "Entries": {
        "74": {
          "ProductID": "(O)279",
          "BurntID": "(O)305",
          "PlacedSound": "clank",
          "CookedSound": "yoba",
          "BurntSound": "debuffHit",
          "ShowSmoke": true,
          "CookTime": 60,
          "BurntAt": 3
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}[/code]
This makes Prismatic Shards cookable, producing Magic Rock Candy (or Void Eggs if burnt). Cook time is in minutes, "Burned" is a multiplier for CookTime, so in this case 60 minutes to cook, 180 minutes until burnt. Use the [b][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Items#Item_IDs]Unqualified Item ID[/url][/b] for the key.


[b][size=4]Custom Cookers[/size][/b]

You can set any placeable object to be cooker using Content Patcher, e.g.:

[code]{
  "Format": "2.7.0",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "EditData",
      "Target": "aedenthorn.SimpleCooking/cooker",
      "Entries": {
        "(O)93": {
          "X": 8,
          "Y": -24,
          "Z": 9.5
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}[/code]
This makes ordinary torches into cookers. Note that most objects can't be turned on and off like the campfire and braziers, but can still be designated as cookers. Use the [b][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Items#Item_IDs]Qualified Item ID[/url][/b] for the key.


[u][size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size][/u]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
